name: Convert Images to Word Document
prompt: Read the content of all the images in the awsome_benchmark folder on the desktop and save it into a Word document. Note that the document content must be kept completely consistent, the format and style must stay the same, and no content may be omitted; the order in which the content connects must be determined by you before proceeding. Save the Word document in the result directory on the desktop.

completion_rubric.name: Correctly read the content of all images in the awsome_benchmark folder on the desktop
Generated a Word document containing the transcription results of the image content

Organized the document content in the correct connection order after judgment

Accurately recognized the text, paragraphs, and layout elements in each image

children.name: Accurately retained the original text content without adding information that does not exist in the images

note: Tests the ability to use OCR tools and to understand text content.
